free_tier.stated: No price-free tier stated; the page has a '免费试用' (free trial) button. Prices: 静态住宅代理 (static residential) $4.8 per IP, 静态数据中心代理 (static datacenter) $0.38 per IP, 动态住宅代理 (dynamic residential) $0.88/GB, 动态手机代理 (dynamic mobile) $2.38/GB.
free_tier.notes: The sign-up page of the same site lists the mobile product at $2.28/GB, against $2.38/GB on the home page. The size of the free trial is unverified: behind a sign-up.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an address or a traffic quota, not an object

retention.stated: not applicable: a proxy session or a rented address, not stored bytes

egress.terms: Static products: '按IP个数收费' (billed per IP), unlimited traffic and concurrency. Dynamic products: '按流量GB收费' (billed per GB), unlimited concurrency, sticky and rotating sessions.

record.interface_detail: SOCKS5 and HTTP; the vendor sells native SOCKS5 residential proxies with API support, QR-code export of proxy details and integrations for fingerprint browsers; targeting down to city.
record.tooling: Any client that speaks an HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 proxy with a username and password or an allowlisted source address: curl -x, python requests, rclone --socks5, or a host-side hop for a runtime that cannot dial a proxy itself. The vendor's help centre carries set-up guides for fingerprint browsers and phone apps.
record.chaining: A host-side hop dials the vendor's HTTP(S) or SOCKS5 endpoint with credentials; the upstream sees an address from the vendor's pool in place of the caller's address.

limits.value: dynamic residential $0.88/GB and mobile $2.38/GB metered per GB; static lines per IP with unlimited traffic

record.limits_note: The vendor claims 10M+ own residential IPs, 190+ countries, Cogent and Equinix backbone partnerships with 1000+ own backbone servers, and ASN, ownership and geolocation customisation for enterprise orders. These are vendor claims, not measured.
record.binding_note: The dynamic lines are metered per GB; the static lines are bought per IP.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form was not rendered in the pages captured (the register page returned only navigation). unverified: behind a sign-up.

record.reliability_note: The operator named on the site is 浙江壹创云信息科技有限公司 with an ICP filing number in the footer. unverified: payment methods, the free-trial size, and the registration class of the static 'native' and 'broadcast' IPs (rung 5): no address was looked up.
record.confidence_note: Prices and product definitions are from the vendor's home page; identity and payment details are unread.
